newsitem.title: USA: Data Transmission buys Cotton Comm assets.
newsitem.headline: Data Transmission buys Cotton Comm assets.

text.p: Data Transmission Network Corp said Monday it acquired the assets of Cotton Communications Network Inc.
The purchase price was not disclosed.

Data Transmission said Cotton operated an electronic trading network service for the cotton industry out of Lubbock, Texas. It said this service is used to help in the process of buying and selling cotton.
The company said it plans to upgrade the computing facilities with new technology. New enhancements will include the ability to handle Firm Offer Trading.
The new service will be called DTN CotNet.

Data Transmission Network said it has more than 1,000 subscribers that are involved in the cotton industry. DTN is an information and communications company with more than 153,000 subscribers in the U.S. and Canada.
The company has services for the agriculture, automotive, energy, golf, produce and other weather-related industries.
